reviews.comment: Professor Gonzenbach is very nice and super helpful, you can tell she really enjoys being an instructor and the information she is teaching. There is a lot of reading, but that's to be expected, I went into this class thinking I would absolutely hate it, but I actually kind of enjoyed some of it.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Gonzenbach made this class my favorite of the year! She's amazing at facilitating productive discussions, and getting everyone to think deeply about whichever book, poem, or film we were analyzing. Her feedback on papers was always helpful, and I genuinely enjoyed writing my take-home final. Her enthusiasm for the material really shows!

Professor Gozenbach was the absolute best! She is so caring and genuinely wants her students to succeed. She is so helpful and her class is so fun! We read some books and even watched movies! Attendance is mandatory if you miss more than 3 classes, it will count against your grade. Overall, I really enjoyed this class!! Highly recommend!!

Professor Gonzenbach is great! I would say her class is more reading intensive than writing intensive, so get ready! She gives you a lot of freedom when it comes to the writing assignments and is a very fair/easy grader. There are 3 essays ranging from 1000-1500 words, one video group project, and one audio book reflection. Great class!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Gonzenbach is a good professor. She asks for a lot of reading- but that should be expected in a literature class!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: TAKE THIS CLASS!! Goose is the best.

TAKE SHANNON!! She is awesome she cares so much and gives a lot of opportunities for success. There are 3 major essays which are the test grades and are not easy but will def help in every way she can if essays are not your thing. There are also a lot of other small grades which help. Please take her she is so sweet!
